content.short: DZap leverages aggregation and zapping to power omnichain liquidity and a unified portfolio manager.
content.description: DZap streamlines DeFi by combining aggregation with zapping, turning fragmented on-chain activity into a cohesive workflow. Its zapping infrastructure powers omnichain liquidity and aggregation. DZap AI leverages natural language processing to interpret user goals and automate on-chain actions, reducing manual steps. In addition, DZap offers a single, unified portfolio manager that lets you view and manage your entire crypto holdings from one clean dashboard.
